title: Use sidebar-owned controls and compact house-style pages
body: The owner explicitly prefers the adjacent legal-ai-app and foundation-e-learning shells over marketing-style dashboard copy. Keep collapse inside the left sidebar, theme switching at bottom-left, horizontal menu divider lines, and concise page/card titles without decorative subtitles or promotional sidebar cards. Pair related charts on desktop and stack on small screens. Retain functional data-quality notices and measured-zone coverage, rather than removing information needed to interpret health data.

title: Put page menus in the shell and dock chat history flush left
body: The owner rejected the floating chat-history card and duplicate titles after providing an e-learning screenshot. The intended layout is one bold page title in the fixed top bar, a full-width section-menu row directly below, and chat history immediately adjacent to the primary navigation with no gutter or outer card. PageMenu supplies controls through a portal into the shell; PageTabs/PagePanel provide keyboard-accessible content sections. Keep these as shared shell furniture rather than recreating page headings or per-page floating toolbars. Geometry tests check header/menu width, one h1, and sidebar adjacency/height on desktop and mobile.
